limits_note: Token/time checks between trials, not hard per-request spend limits; hard limit three fresh episodes with twenty actions each.
paired_inputs: Identical frozen reward and held-out inputs for the two three-capacity profiles; contract-specific inputs for single-capacity.
stop: No model before all source-bound gates and tool checks pass; preserve every started episode; no success-seeking replacement trials.
questions: Does independent solving succeed at single-credit vs depth-three with fixed base tools?
Does the richer event laboratory get used at the same depth-three contract? Small n, no causal or saturation conclusion.
excluded: No training, no additional capability products, no PPA rewards, no more than three model trials.
revision_reason: Require actual ledger-hook execution before accepting a PASS; no model has started.
